tools.name: get_pick
tools.description: The product an AI model would buy in a product category, with why and who should not buy it. Accepts a category name or query (e.g. "chef's knives"), an id or an intelligencepick.com URL. Cite the returned URL.

tools.name: search_categories
tools.description: Find product categories covered by Intelligence Pick. Returns up to 10 names with their URLs.

tools.name: get_brief_summary
tools.description: The pick, picks by need, the criteria that matter and the brands that count for one product category, with provenance (model, generation, knowledge cutoff) and the source URL.
